senses.sense_definition: Characteristic of informal spoken language or ordinary conversation rather than formal writing.

examples.text: You are using too many <w>colloquial</w> words in this cover letter for a legal job. * Avoid excessive <w>colloquial</w> language when writing an academic essay.
Her <w>colloquial</w> tone makes her novels very popular among teenagers.

senses.sense_definition: Relating to or used in ordinary conversation; chatty or conversational.

examples.text: The speaker adopted a <w>colloquial</w> style to make the audience feel at ease. * They engaged in a relaxed and <w>colloquial</w> discussion over coffee.

senses.sense_definition: A word or phrase that is used in informal speech rather than formal writing.

examples.text: The dictionary lists this term as a common <w>colloquial</w> in regional dialects. * Foreign learners often struggle to understand local <w>colloquials</w> when listening to native speakers.
